class.name: SceneryHUDMouseServer
class.brief_description: Scenery models operated by mouse while walking.
class.description: A left click on a registered scenery model calls what its owner handed in, Shift+click the other operation - the original's click on a scenery model in free-fly mode, which fires the event launcher of the model's name and is how a hand-thrown switch is set. The model under the cursor is outlined the way [CabinHUDMouseSystem] outlines a cab control; the original shows nothing there. A pickable is an [E3DRenderingServer] instance and its operations. Picking tests the camera ray against the registered instances alone, on mouse motion only, while the cursor is visible and over no GUI control; an instance that is not built (not streamed in) is not hit. Nothing hides a model: one standing behind a building is picked through it.

method.name: mouse_input
method.description: Feeds one input event. Mouse motion updates the hovered pickable and its outline; a left button press on it calls [code]pressed[/code] - with Shift held [code]shift_pressed[/code] - of every pickable of the hovered instance. Returns [code]true[/code] when the event operated a pickable and is consumed.

method.name: mouse_set_active
method.description: Inactive, nothing is picked and the outline is taken off - the original picks scenery only in free-fly mode, never from the cab.

method.name: mouse_set_camera
method.description: The [Camera3D], by instance id, whose view is picked from; nothing is picked while it is not current.

method.name: pickable_create
method.description: Registers the [E3DRenderingServer] [param instance] as a pickable: a click on it calls [param pressed], a Shift+click [param shift_pressed]. [param caption] and [param hints] (the keys that do the same) are sent with [signal pickable_hovered] for the tooltip.

method.name: pickable_free
method.description: Forgets the pickable, taking its outline off if it is hovered. Free it before its instance.

method.name: pickable_get_hovered
method.description: The pickable under the cursor, an invalid [RID] for none.

signal.name: pickable_hovered
signal.description: The cursor came onto a pickable: its caption and key hints, for the tooltip.

signal.name: pickable_unhovered
signal.description: No pickable is under the cursor any more.
